question: Can residual state-selection freedom on h_vec be reduced further using P1, P2, exterior physics, semiclassical backreaction, and thermodynamic passivity?

executive_verdict.summary: Yes. Positive-energy residual additions are excluded from the exact P1 background, and background equilibrium replacement states reduce to Hawking-KMS candidates. Full state uniqueness still requires a full exterior-generator embedding theorem or joint-observable exhaustion theorem.
executive_verdict.passivity_reduction_status: DERIVED/THEOREM on the defined equilibrium class
executive_verdict.fixed_generator_kms_status: DERIVED/THEOREM conditional on fixed exterior generator

theorems.name: Positive-Energy Residual Addition Exclusion
theorems.claim: A nonzero positive residual covariance increment on strictly positive coexact shell modes is not exact-P1 background-admissible if it adds exterior energy, flux, or stress-energy not already included in the banked Hawking background.
chain: positivity of the one-particle energy generator
positivity of quasifree bosonic energy expectation

theorems.name: Non-Hawking Flux Exclusion
theorems.claim: A residual state producing independent non-Hawking net horizon flux is not admissible as the fixed P1 background state.
chain: semiclassical stress-energy conservation on fixed Schwarzschild background

theorems.name: Horizon Symmetry Stress Exclusion
theorems.claim: A residual state producing anisotropic horizon stress-energy incompatible with the round Schwarzschild horizon is not admissible as the fixed P1 background state.
chain: spherical symmetry of Schwarzschild horizon geometry
standard QFT stress-energy transformation under rotations

theorems.name: Complete Passivity Implies KMS
theorems.scope: defined background equilibrium residual state class
theorems.claim: A faithful normal completely passive equilibrium state for the exterior horizon time flow is a KMS state, with the Schwarzschild thermal branch at Hawking inverse temperature.

theorems.name: Fixed-Generator Quasifree KMS Uniqueness
theorems.scope: CCR algebra with fixed positive exterior one-particle generator
theorems.claim: For a fixed positive one-particle generator H_ext, the gauge-invariant quasifree beta_H-KMS covariance is unique: G_beta = (exp(beta_H H_ext)-1)^(-1).
chain: fixed positive exterior one-particle generator H_ext

theorems.name: Backreaction-Passivity Residual Reduction
theorems.claim: Within the exterior-realizable background-state class, residual freedom reduces to stress-energy-null/gauge-null residuals or replacement-state freedom in sectors whose exterior one-particle generator or Hartle-Hawking restriction embedding has not yet been proved.

remaining_gap.name: Full Exterior-Generator Embedding Theorem
remaining_gap.statement_needed: The physical one-particle dynamics on the complete lifted carrier h_vec is the restriction of the exterior Schwarzschild Hawking/Hartle-Hawking one-particle generator to the coexact bridge carrier.
remaining_gap.why_needed: Without it, passivity reduces equilibrium states to KMS candidates but cannot select the unique full covariance on every residual shell.

routes_exhausted.verdict: successful but scoped; it kills DeltaG >= 0 physical additions with positive energy, not arbitrary signed replacement states
successful but scoped; excludes states that alter Schwarzschild flux or spherical symmetry
successful reduction; forces equilibrium states to be KMS candidates
successful conditional theorem; covariance is unique once H_ext is fixed
does not close full state selection because it does not identify the full residual one-particle generator

must_not_overclaim: Do not claim full h_vec state selection is closed.
Do not claim passivity selects a unique full covariance without fixed-generator identification.
Do not claim positive-energy exclusion handles arbitrary signed covariance replacement states.
Do not claim P1 alone proves the full exterior Hawking generator on h_vec.
